title: Fix missing Admin Panel navigation link in Layout

requirements.text: In Layout.tsx, add a visible 'Admin Panel' navigation link that is conditionally rendered only for admin users (using `useIsCallerAdmin` or the equivalent admin-check hook already used in the codebase). The link must navigate to the `/admin` route. It must appear in both the desktop navigation and the mobile menu, and must be reliably visible without requiring any overflow/dropdown menu interaction.

quotes: see you only there is no admin panel

acceptanceCriteria: When logged in as an admin user, an 'Admin Panel' link is visible in the main navigation header.
The link is also present in the mobile menu for admin users.
Clicking the link navigates to the /admin route which renders AdminPanel.tsx.
Non-admin authenticated users do not see the Admin Panel link.
Unauthenticated users do not see the Admin Panel link.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not change the /admin route definition or AdminPanel.tsx logic.
The admin check must use the existing hook pattern already present in the codebase (e.g., useIsCallerAdmin or equivalent from useQueries.ts).
nonGoals: Changing the AdminPanel page content or functionality.
Modifying access control logic in the backend.
